easyPrerequisites:
You control at least four lands.
Dual Casting and Umbral Mantle are attached to the same creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure for each land you control. 
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}
Activate the creature by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.
